children: byNordic Acquisition entered into a no-interest promissory note of up to $150,000 with Thomas L. Fairfield to bolster working capital and fund extension deposits. The initial advance was $8,850.20. The note is payable upon the closing of the company’s initial business combination or 180 days after dissolution, at the lender’s discretion to extend. If no business combination occurs, repayment is limited to funds held outside the SPAC trust account.
